info.name: Third Party API Demo
info.description: Postman requests and assertions for the local API that proxies JSONPlaceholder.

item.name: Get five posts from third-party API

exec: pm.test('Returns up to five posts', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array').and.have.lengthOf.at.most(5); });
pm.test('Posts have title and body', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0]).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0]).to.have.property('body'); });

item.name: Create a demo post (simulated upstream write)

exec: pm.test('Echoes the submitted title', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().title).to.eql('Postman demo'); });
